arxiv-1907-06125.title: Integrality over ideal semifiltrations updated and improved version of undergraduate work from 2010
arxiv-1907-06125.creator: Darij Grinberg
arxiv-1907-06125.description: Abstract Abstract. We study integrality over rings (all commutative in this paper) and over ideal semifiltrations (a generalization of integrality over ideals). We begin by reproving classical results, such as a version of the “faithful module” criterion for integrality over a ring, the transitivity of integrality, and the theorem that sums and products of integral elements are again integral.

arxiv-2101-12192.title: Fully Geant4 compatible package for the simulation of Dark Matter in fixed target experiments
arxiv-2101-12192.creator: M. Bondi, A. Celentano, R. R. Dusaev, D. V. Kirpichnikov, M. M. Kirsanov, N. V. Krasnikov, L. Marsicano, D. Shchukin
arxiv-2101-12192.description: Abstract We present the package for the simulation of DM (Dark Matter) particles in fixed target experiments. The most convenient way of this simulation (and the only possible way in the case of beam-dump) is to simulate it in the framework of the Monte-Carlo program performing the particle tracing in the experimental setup.

arxiv-2104-14977.title: Linear Convergence of the Subspace Constrained Mean Shift Algorithm: From Euclidean to Directional Data
arxiv-2104-14977.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by [. This paper studies the linear convergence of the subspace constrained mean shift (SCMS) algorithm, a well-known algorithm for identifying a density ridge defined by a kernel density estimator. By arguing that the SCMS algorithm is a special variant of a subspace constrained gradient ascent (SCGA) algorithm with an adaptive step size, we derive the linear convergence of such SCGA algorithm.

arxiv-2201-10193.title: L L -values of harmonic Maass forms
arxiv-2201-10193.creator: Nikolaos Diamantis, Larry Rolen
arxiv-2201-10193.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Nikolaos Diamantis, Larry Rolen. Bruinier, Funke, and Imamoglu have proved a formula for what can philosophically be called the “central L L -value” of the modular j j -invariant. Previously, this had been heuristically suggested by Zagier. Here, we interpret this “ L L -value” as the value of an actual L L -series, and extend it to all integral arguments and to a large class of harmonic Maass forms which includes all weakly holomorphic cusp forms.

arxiv-2308-02868.title: Dynamics of charge imbalance resolved negativity after a local joining quench
arxiv-2308-02868.creator: Hui-Huang Chen, Zun-Xian Huang
arxiv-2308-02868.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the dynamics of charge imbalance resolved negativity after a local joining quench in the 1 + 1 1+1 dimensional free complex boson CFT. In the first part, we study the local joining quench by applying conformal maps, obtaining analytical universal results. We first calculate the quench dynamics of charged logarithmic negativity.

arxiv-2310-08775.title: When Machine Learning Models Leak: An Exploration of Synthetic Training Data
arxiv-2310-08775.creator: Manel Slokom, Peter-Paul de Wolf, Martha Larson
arxiv-2310-08775.description: Abstract We investigate an attack on a machine learning model that predicts whether a person or household will relocate in the next two years, i.e., a propensity-to-move classifier. The attack assumes that the attacker can query the model to obtain predictions and that the marginal distributions of the data set on which the model was trained are publicly available.

arxiv-2311-13837.title: Non-axisymmetric modes in ultrathin annular liquid films coating a cylindrical fibre Preprint: Accepted in Phys. Fluids
arxiv-2311-13837.creator: D. Moreno-Boza, A. Sevilla
arxiv-2311-13837.description: Abstract This paper presents a detailed analysis of the three-dimensional stability properties of an annular liquid film coating a cylindrical fibre in the presence of van der Waals (vdW) interactions, whose influence depends on the wettability of the solid by the liquid.

arxiv-2402-18884.title: Supervised Contrastive Representation Learning: Landscape Analysis with Unconstrained Features This work is supported by an NSERC Discovery Grant, a CRG8-KAUST award, and funding from AML-TN program at UBC.
arxiv-2402-18884.creator: Tina Behnia, Christos Thrampoulidis
arxiv-2402-18884.description: Abstract Recent findings reveal that over-parameterized deep neural networks, trained beyond zero training-error, exhibit a distinctive structural pattern at the final layer, termed as Neural-collapse (NC). These results indicate that the final hidden-layer outputs in such networks display minimal within-class variations over the training set.

arxiv-2404-09202.title: Anomalous magnetoentropic response of skrymion crystals
arxiv-2404-09202.creator: Ahmed R. Saikia, Narayan Mohanta
arxiv-2404-09202.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Ahmed R. Saikia, Narayan Mohanta. We investigate theoretically magnetoentropic signatures of the crystal phase of magnetic skyrmions of various kinds, commonly appearing in two dimensions, viz. , Néel, Bloch and anti skyrmions. Using Monte Carlo calculations based on spin Hamiltonians, we obtain magnetic entropy change Δ ​ S m \Delta S_{m} in the presence of three different types of Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions responsible for these skyrmions.

arxiv-2409-09359.title: Symbolic Regression with a Learned Concept Library
arxiv-2409-09359.creator: Arya Grayeli, Atharva Sehgal, Omar Costilla-Reyes, Miles Cranmer, Swarat Chaudhuri
arxiv-2409-09359.description: Abstract We present a novel method for symbolic regression (SR), the task of searching for compact programmatic hypotheses that best explain a dataset. The problem is commonly solved using genetic algorithms; we show that we can enhance such methods by inducing a library of abstract textual concepts.

arxiv-2508-13851.title: The Unexplored Dusty Nova LMCN 2009-05a in the Large Magellanic Cloud
arxiv-2508-13851.creator: Mohit Singh Bisht, A. Raj, F. M. Walter, Anatoly S. Miroshnichenko, D. Bisht, K. Belwal, Shraddha Biswas
arxiv-2508-13851.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mohit Singh Bisht, A. Raj, F. M. Walter, Anatoly S. Miroshnichenko, D. Bisht, K. Belwal, Shraddha Biswas. We present a detailed spectrophotometric study of nova LMCN 2009-05a, located in the Large Magellanic Cloud (LMC). Photometric observations reveal a dust dip in the optical light curve, classifying it as a D-class nova. Light curve analysis yields t 2 t_{2} and t 3 t_{3} decline times of approximately 46 and 80 days, respectively, placing the nova in the category of moderately fast novae.

arxiv-2509-19584.title: One-sided Fractional Integrals and Riesz Potentials on a Spherical Cap
arxiv-2509-19584.creator: B. Rubin
arxiv-2509-19584.description: Abstract . We introduce fractional integrals on the n n -dimensional spherical cap, study their boundednes in weighted L p L^{p} spaces and obtain explicit inversion formulas. The results are applied to the inversion problem for Riesz potentials on a spherical cap.

arxiv-2602-13784.title: Comparables XAI: Faithful Example-based AI Explanations with Counterfactual Trace Adjustments Conference: Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 13–17, 2026; Barcelona, Spain Proceedings of the 2026 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CH
arxiv-2602-13784.creator: Yifan Zhang, Tianle Ren, Fei Wang, Brian Y Lim
arxiv-2602-13784.description: Abstract . Explaining with examples is an intuitive way to justify AI decisions. However, it is challenging to understand how a decision value should change relative to the examples with many features differing by large amounts. We draw from real estate valuation that uses Comparables—examples with known values for comparison.

arxiv-2603-05557.creator: Alessia Biondi, Scott Robertson, Germain Rousseaux

pmc-10827934.title: The effects of metabolic indicators and immune biomarkers on pregnancy outcomes in women with recurrent spontaneous abortion: a retrospective study
pmc-10827934.creator: Jie Zhang, Zhan Song, Hui Yuan, Zhu-Hua Cai
pmc-10827934.description: BackgroundThe etiology of recurrent spontaneous abortion (RSA) remains elusive despite specific investigations affirming the association between RSA and thyroid autoimmunity (TAI). This study explores the immunological and metabolic profiles of RSA patients exhibiting positive thyroid antibodies and their connection with the rates of first-trimester miscarriage and live births. The aim is to provide further guidance for clinical interventions.

pmc-11357177.title: In Vitro Evaluation of the Combinatorial Effect of Naringenin and Miltefosine against Leishmania amazonensis
pmc-11357177.creator: Vinícius Lopes Lessa, Gustavo Gonçalves, Beatriz Santos, Victoria Cruz Cavalari, Rafael Felipe da Costa Vieira, Fabiano Borges Figueiredo, Maria de Lourdes Pereira, Veeranoot Nissapatorn, Ana Paula Girol, Sónia M R Oliveira, Ilkay Erdogan Orhan
pmc-11357177.description: Leishmania amazonensis causes a clinical form called diffuse cutaneous leishmaniasis (DCL) with challenges to treatment, like low efficiency and drug toxicity. Therefore, it is necessary to investigate new therapies using less toxic leishmanicidal compounds, such as flavonoids like naringenin, and their combination with conventional drugs, such as miltefosine.

pmc-11366003.title: Comparison of clustering and phenotyping approaches for subclassification of type 2 diabetes and its association with remission in Indian population
pmc-11366003.creator: Pramod Tripathi, Anagha Vyawahare, Nidhi Kadam, Diptika Tiwari, Mayurika Das Biswas, Thejas Kathrikolly, Baby Sharma, Venugopal Vijayakumar, Maheshkumar Kuppusamy
pmc-11366003.description: Identification of novel subgroups of type 2 diabetes (T2D) has helped improve its management. Most classification techniques focus on clustering or subphenotyping but not on both. This study aimed to compare both these methods and examine the rate of T2D remission in these subgroups in the Indian population.

pmc-12653289.title: CITED Proteins in Cardiac Development and Lifelong Heart Function
pmc-12653289.creator: José Bragança, Rute Luísa Cabrita Pinto, Igor Ventura, Silvana Ferreira, António Marreiros, David Alan Rizzieri
pmc-12653289.description: The CITED proteins function as transcriptional modulators that are essential for vertebrate development. These proteins interact with numerous partners, notably transcription factors and co-activators. The hallmark of the CITED family is their conserved carboxy-terminal domain, which interacts strongly with the CBP/p300 co-activators.

pmc-12780097.title: Continental scale geographic analysis of hospital exposure to natural hazards in the Americas
pmc-12780097.creator: Leonardo Hernandez, Patricia Najera Hamrick, Alex Camacho-Vasconez, Patricio Yépez-Castro, Enrique Pérez-Gutiérrez, Ciro Ugarte, Juan S Izquierdo-Condoy, Diana Alban, Esteban Ortiz-Prado, Juan Carlos Sanchez
pmc-12780097.description: Natural hazards—including earthquakes, hurricanes, floods, landslides, and volcanic activity—pose substantial threats to healthcare systems in the Americas. This study aims to evaluate the exposure of primary, secondary, and tertiary hospitals across the Americas to natural hazards and to identify the most affected areas and hospital facilities.

pmc-13143194.title: “Optimizing Learning in Integrated Curriculum”—Comparative Effectiveness of Online and Face-to-Face Formative Assessments: Mixed Methods Study
pmc-13143194.creator: Amira Salem Ismail, Sarah Mohamed Hussein, Mohamed El-Shafey, Ahmed Farid Al-Neklawy, Ahd A Mansour, Shatha Ghazi Felemban, Shimaa Elaraby
pmc-13143194.description: BackgroundAssessment is a critical component of teaching and learning and serves as the foundation for how learners demonstrate success in achieving learning objectives. Formative assessments (FAs) and timely feedback play a crucial role in integrated curricula, whereas basic and clinical sciences are taught in a coordinated manner.

pmc-13200446.title: Single-cell and spatial transcriptomics analyses reveal tumor microenvironment–driven proliferation of NF2-associated vestibular schwannomas
pmc-13200446.creator: Ying Wang, Gang Xu, Yuan Ren, Tao Pan, Ya Zhang, Yanan Liu, Zhijun Yang, Zheng Zhao, Peng Li, Minjun Yan, Chao Zhang, Bo Wang, Xin Ma, Yongsheng Li, Juan Xu, Pinan Liu
pmc-13200446.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The tumor microenvironment (TME) is crucial for tumor formation and progression, but its specific impact on NF2-related tumors has not been well described. The aim of this study was to analyze the differences in the TME among NF2-related schwannomatosis (NF2-SWN) patients with different clinical phenotypes, explore the reasons for these differences, and identify targets for treatment while gaining a deeper understanding of the pathogenesis of the disease.

pmc-13269546.title: Methylation biomarkers in non-regressive cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 lesions: an epigenome wide association study
pmc-13269546.creator: Laura Burney Ellis, Sarah J. Bowden, Maria Paraskevaidi, Deirdre Lyons, Evangelos Paraskevaidis, Anna-Barbara Moscicki, James M. Flanagan, Maria Kyrgiou
pmc-13269546.description: BackgroundDNA methylation has been proposed as a predictive biomarker. Cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 (CIN2) was historically the cut-off for surgical treatment, however it is increasingly managed with active surveillance, while there is currently no accurate way to predict which lesions will regress.

pmc-13466145.title: Pre-implementation factors for Active Music Engagement (AME): barriers and facilitators to integrating an evidence-based dyadic intervention into pediatric oncology care
pmc-13466145.creator: Kristin M. Story, Elizabeth Harman, Kristin Stegenga, Jelena Golubovic, Sheri L. Robb
pmc-13466145.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPediatric cancer treatment is a difficult and distressing experience that often results in sustained, interrelated distress in young children and parents, and traumatic stress symptoms for some parents. Few evidence-based interventions address this dyadic distress. Active Music Engagement (AME) is a manualized, evidence-based music play intervention that significantly reduces distress in child/parent dyads and mitigates traumatic stress and improves well-being among highly distressed parents and those experiencing sociodemographic risk. Successfully integrating AME into standard care requires a systematic understanding of implementation factors.

uslaw-usc-t14-s2777.title: 14 U.S.C. § 2777 — Clothing for destitute shipwrecked individuals
uslaw-usc-t14-s2777.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t14-s2777.description: United States Code, Title 14 (Coast Guard); Chapter 27 (Pay, Allowances, Awards, And Other Rights And Benefits); Subchapter III (Payments). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Coast Guard may furnish clothing and subsistence to destitute shipwrecked individuals, and the Coast Guard may reimburse, in cash or in kind, Coast Guard personnel who furnish clothing and subsistence to destitute shipwrecked individuals.

uslaw-usc-t43-s908.title: 43 U.S.C. § 908 — Deposits by railroad companies for costs of surveying and conveying unsurveyed lands granted
uslaw-usc-t43-s908.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t43-s908.description: United States Code, Title 43 (Public Lands); Chapter 21 (Grants In Aid Of Railroads And Wagon Roads). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. To enable the Secretary of the Interior to complete the adjustment of land grants made by Congress to aid in the construction of railroads, and to subject the lands granted to taxation by States, Territories, and municipal authorities, any railroad.
